title: Dark Ritual (not cast by Velox / Lagopus)
problem: Dark Ritual raises the caster's Attack and Speed, so it is a stat-manipulating spell by its own text, but its internal category is UTILITY. Velox and Lagopus only pick BOOST / DEBOOST gems, so they never cast it.
notes: Text: Velox / Lagopus: "... first 3 permanent, stat-manipulating Spell Gems each have a 50% / 20% chance to be {ACTION_cast} automatically at the start of battle." | Dark Ritual: ... Evidence: Spell DB field 4 of id 35 = "UTILITY" (store @0x1458dd6b2, scr_DatabaseSpellGems); filter bc_StartupCasting L153 @0x1416c634d (Velox), L293 @0x1416c8f5d (Lagopus). Fix sketch: Do NOT retag: a BOOST tag would also make Temptation R100 copy a 'kill your ally' spell onto the bearer and make the Enchanter offer Stat +/- (Malachite), which can't act on a fixed 100% transfer. Instead redirect the tag test in bc_StartupCasting at L153 (Velox, block from @0x1416c634d) and L293 (Lagopus, @0x1416c8f5d) to a C hook that returns 'stat spell' for BOOST / DEBOOST tags OR spell id 35 / 37 (and, with #5, not for 22). Reasoning: 'Stat-manipulating' is not defined anywhere in the game's text, so it reads in plain language; Dark Ritual changes stats. The code uses a hidden tag that disagrees with that reading. App note (unpatched game): Velox and Lagopus never cast Dark Ritual, because the game files it as a utility spell even though it gives stats. Source: errata round 2 (2026-10-26). | Patch (batch L): bc_StartupCasting L153 (Velox) @0x1416c64a3 and L293 (Lagopus) @0x1416c90b3: the '> 0' test after string_pos("DEBOOST", tag) goes to a hook that is also true for spell 35 (and 37 with SU-0229 on); the gem's spellid value is the one the line just read ([rbp+0x460] / [rbp+0x410], rbp = rsp + 0x100). No retag, so Temptation rank 100 and the Enchanter are unchanged. Dark Ritual's 'target ally is killed' still applies when it is cast this way.

release_notes.effect: Velox and Lagopus (traits) with Dark Ritual
release_notes.intended: The first 3 permanent, stat-manipulating Spell Gems have a chance to be cast at the start of battle.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, Dark Ritual was never picked although it gives the caster Attack and Speed, because the game files it as a utility spell.
release_notes.fix: Now Dark Ritual counts as a stat-manipulating Spell Gem for Velox and Lagopus.
